cases.title: Đổi tiêu đề một khối ở trang chủ
cases.why: The commonest weekly ask: one heading, named by its visible words, replaced by the customer's text, with every other word on the page left alone. Fast road: One words-replace on the heading text, one read of the receipt; about 2 steps. Wrong road: Rewrites the whole home body or block group from memory and loses a neighbouring heading (caught by has on {sectionH2b}). Wrong road: Edits a second page that repeats the words, or leaves the old heading beside the new one (caught by gone on {sectionH2} and unchanged on innerPage).
turns: Ở trang chủ, đổi tiêu đề “{sectionH2}” thành “How we work with you”.
cases.notes: Heading is a field of the entry in the home collection; tracy_emdash list first, then a content update; tool writes show at once (rebuild is only for changes under /app).

cases.title: Chọn một tiêu đề trên trang rồi đổi chữ
cases.why: The same edit as M-L1-heading-chat, but the target arrives as a picked element: the pick usually lands on the container around the heading, not on the heading itself. Fast road: Read the picked element, find the heading words inside it, one words-replace on those words. Wrong road: Treats the picked container as the heading and rewrites the whole block, dropping the sentence under it (caught by has on {sectionH2bLead}). Wrong road: Changes the neighbouring heading or leaves the old one next to the new one (caught by has on {sectionH2} and gone on {sectionH2b}).
cases.notes: The picked block maps to a field of the home entry (section heading); update that field only.

cases.title: Đổi chữ trên nút, giữ nguyên đường link
cases.why: A button label changes while its destination must not: the label and the link are separate things inside one element. Fast road: Replace only the label text of that button (one words-replace); read the receipt. Wrong road: Deletes and recreates the button, so its link is lost or reset (caught by linkHref on the new label). Wrong road: Changes the label in the page body but leaves the old label as a second link elsewhere on the page (caught by noLinkText on {cta1}).
turns: Ở trang chủ, đổi chữ trên nút “{cta1}” thành “Get in touch”, giữ nguyên đường link.
cases.notes: Button of the hero block of the home entry: label and href are separate fields; update the label field only.

cases.title: Bỏ câu cuối của một đoạn
cases.why: Trim one sentence from a multi-sentence paragraph without touching the rest of the paragraph or any other page. Fast road: Find the paragraph from the quoted sentence, one replace of that sentence by an empty string, read the receipt back. Wrong road: Rewrites the whole paragraph from the model's memory instead of removing one sentence (caught by has on the first sentence, which must stay word for word). Wrong road: Removes the same sentence everywhere it repeats, including the home page (caught by unchanged on home).
turns: Bỏ câu “{para2Last}” ở cuối đoạn, phần còn lại của đoạn giữ nguyên.
cases.notes: Field of the entry in the page collection (about, services_page…); tool writes show at once.

cases.title: Chọn một đoạn rồi thêm câu vào cuối đoạn
cases.why: Insert a sentence at a named place of a picked paragraph: the new words must land inside that paragraph, after the existing sentence, and the old sentence must stay word for word. Fast road: Read the picked paragraph, one replace that appends the sentence to its last sentence, read the receipt. Wrong road: Replaces the paragraph with the new sentence alone, so the old words disappear (caught by has on {para1}). Wrong road: Adds the sentence as a separate paragraph or at the end of the page instead of inside the picked paragraph (caught by words: the element holding {para1} must also hold the new sentence).

turns.say: Thêm vào cuối đoạn này câu “Our team checks every request by hand.”

has: Our team checks every request by hand.

words.has: Our team checks every request by hand.

cases.notes: Rich-text (portable text) field of the page entry: keep the paragraph and add the sentence to its end.

cases.title: Tạo trang Hỏi đáp 3 câu và thêm vào menu đầu trang
cases.why: Two dependent jobs in one message: a new page built from given sections in a stated order, then its menu entry at a named position (the page must exist before the menu can point at it). Fast road: Create the page with the three question and answer pairs, then add one menu item after the named entry; two writes, one read of each receipt. Wrong road: Creates the page but never adds it to the menu, so the customer has no way to reach it (caught by follow:home:… which needs a link on the home page). Wrong road: Puts the menu item before the named entry, or writes the answers merged into one paragraph or in the wrong order (caught by orderBefore on home and by the question and answer chain on the new page).
turns: Tạo trang “Common questions” gồm 3 câu hỏi theo đúng thứ tự: (1) “How fast do you reply?” — “Within one working day.” (2) “Do you work weekends?” — “No, Monday to Friday only.” (3) “Can I visit your office?” — “Yes, please book a time first.” Thêm trang vào menu đầu trang ngay sau mục “{navItem}”.

has: Yes, please book a time first.
orderBefore: Yes, please book a time first.

cases.notes: content_create in the pages collection (published), then menu_get and menu_set_items with every item of the primary menu (it writes the whole menu).
cases.oracleNote: D farm 05/10/2026: unchanged innerPage → innerPage@main (the menu link the case asks for is on every page)

cases.title: Đổi tên một thẻ trong nhóm thẻ, các thẻ khác giữ nguyên
cases.why: One item of a repeated group (cards, service list) is renamed while its siblings survive: the items often live together in one array. Fast road: Update only the one item field; read the receipt back to see the siblings are still there. Wrong road: Overwrites the whole array of items with one item, so the neighbouring cards vanish (caught by has on {card2}). Wrong road: Edits the wrong card (off by one) or leaves the old title as well (caught by gone on {card1}).
turns: Đổi tên thẻ “{card1}” thành “Planning made simple”, các thẻ khác giữ nguyên.
cases.notes: Cards are rows of a repeater field of the entry: update only the title of that row.

cases.title: Đổi số fax khi site không có số fax
cases.why: The customer asks to change a field the site does not have: the agent must say so (or ask where to add it) and write nothing, not invent a fax line. Fast road: Look once for a fax number, find none, answer that there is no fax on the site and ask whether to add one; no write. Wrong road: Creates a new fax line somewhere to satisfy the request (caught by gone on the fax number on home and innerPage). Wrong road: Edits the phone number instead of the fax (caught by unchanged on home and innerPage).
turns: Đổi số fax trong phần thông tin liên hệ thành +1 202 555 0199.
cases.notes: No fax field in the site-settings or contact entry: read once, answer, do not write.

cases.title: Gửi ảnh trong chat làm ảnh lớn đầu trang chủ
cases.why: What a customer does first: attach a photo to the chat and say "use this one as the big picture". Either the customer file reaches the hero, or the agent says plainly that an attachment cannot be placed, points to the Files tab and changes nothing; it must never pass a drawn or demo picture off as the customer file. Fast road: If a door carries the attachment: one upload and one hero write, about 3 calls. If none does (the state on 29/09: the model sees the picture, nothing hands it to the media library): one honest sentence naming the Files tab, zero writes. Wrong road: Draws or reuses another site picture and reports it as the customer photo (caught by picture fixture on the hero in the done branch; in the refusal branch by unchanged + answerHas Files). Wrong road: Loops on base64 or shell tricks to smuggle the attachment, then says done while the page still shows the old hero (caught by the same fixture check and the step budget). Wrong road: Also swaps a project card picture "to keep the page consistent" (caught by picture src same on the first project card).

turns.say: Dùng ảnh này làm ảnh lớn ở đầu trang chủ.

cases.notes: media.upload gives a media id; write it into the hero image field of the `home` entry (an id, not a URL). Content writes show without rebuild.

cases.title: Đổi tên một mục menu đầu trang, giữ nguyên link
cases.why: A menu label belongs to the menu item, not to the page it points to: the item must read the new word on every page, keep its link, and the target page must keep its own title. Fast road: Read the menu once, one write on the item title (WordPress navigation block / Joomla menu item / EmDash menu_set_items with every item), check two pages. Wrong road: Renames the target page (its title and slug), which changes the menu word as a side effect and breaks links (caught by home@main has the old H1 and linkHref still ending with the old path). Wrong road: Edits only the home page header and leaves the inner-page header or the mobile menu on the old word (caught by innerPage@top noLinkText). Wrong road: On EmDash sends only the changed item to the menu write and drops the other items (caught by linkText on a neighbouring item).
turns: Đổi tên mục “{navItem}” trên menu đầu trang thành “Support”. Link giữ nguyên.
cases.notes: menu_get {name} then menu_set_items {name, items} with EVERY item (the call replaces the whole menu).

cases.title: Đổi tiêu đề hiện trên Google của trang Liên hệ
cases.why: The Google title is the page title tag, a different field from the visible H1: it must change in the head only, on that one page. Fast road: Read the head of the contact page, one write on its SEO/browser title field, read the served head back. 2 calls. Wrong road: Rewrites the visible heading of the page to the new text (caught by contact@main gone the new text). Wrong road: Changes the title on every page through a template or site-wide option (caught by unchanged on home). Wrong road: Reports done while the title tag is still the old one because no SEO field was written (caught by meta title has and changed).
turns: Tiêu đề hiện trên Google của trang Liên hệ đổi thành “Contact us | Free quote”.
cases.notes: SEO field of the page entry if its collection has one; the template head wins over the panel (where.seo).

cases.title: Hỏi trang chủ đang có những khối nội dung nào (chỉ đọc, không sửa)
cases.why: A read-only question about the page: the answer must name the real blocks, and nothing may be written to the site. Fast road: One read of the home page (page text or one content read), answer from it; zero write calls. Wrong road: Answers from memory or from the demo content instead of reading the live page, so the block titles are wrong (caught by answerHas on the two real block titles). Wrong road: Treats "kể ngắn gọn" as a go-ahead and edits or tidies something, or re-saves a block (caught by unchanged on the home and inner pages).
turns: Trang chủ đang có những khối nội dung nào? Kể ngắn gọn, chưa sửa gì nhé.
cases.notes: Read the page entry fields through the site tools or the page text; no write and no rebuild.

cases.title: Tạm tắt form liên hệ vì spam, rồi bật lại y như cũ
cases.why: Switch the contact form off (turn 1), then back on EXACTLY as it was (turn 2): same fields, same required marks, nothing lost. Fast road: One write that removes/hides the form, one revert or restore of the same write; read the page once after turn 1 because the effect is not in the receipt. Wrong road: Reports "done" after a setting write that has no visible effect on that page, so the form is still shown (caught by hidden on the form label after turn 1). Wrong road: Rebuilds the form from memory on turn 2 and loses a field or a required mark (caught by the form rule with all fields and required marks after turn 2). Wrong road: Turns the form off on other pages or edits the home page (caught by unchanged on the home page).
turns: Form liên hệ đang bị spam, tạm tắt form giúp mình.
Hết spam rồi, bật lại form y như cũ.
cases.notes: Set the contact entry form binding empty (content update), then restore it; touch no template file; measured v6: PASS.

cases.title: Đổi hai tiêu đề, rồi trả lại một cái, giữ cái kia
cases.why: Partial undo inside one multi-edit message: only the second change is reverted, the first stays. Fast road: Two writes carrying their own apply ids; revert exactly the second one (or write the old value back) and leave the first. Wrong road: Reverts both edits, or "undoes" by retyping both headings from memory (caught by has on the first new heading after turn 2). Wrong road: Leaves the second new heading in place and only says it is reverted (caught by gone on the second new heading). Wrong road: Restores the second heading with slightly different words or case (caught by has on the original second heading, word for word).
turns: Ở trang chủ đổi tiêu đề “{sectionH2}” thành “How we work with you” và “{sectionH2b}” thành “What our clients say”.
Cái thứ hai trả lại như cũ, cái thứ nhất giữ.
cases.notes: Entry fields: the old value is the one read before the write; write it back for the second heading only; rebuild before reading the page.

cases.title: Đổi màu nền một nút, chỉ nút đó
cases.why: Scope discipline for a one-element style: the named button changes background at both device widths while every other button keeps the colour measured before the case. Fast road: One scoped style on that single button (the block, module or component that owns it) with no token touched, then read the receipt back. Two to four calls. Wrong road: Edits the primary colour token or the theme accent so every button turns blue (caught by the baseline colour checks on the other CTA, the secondary button and the header button). Wrong road: Writes the rule inside a desktop-only media query, or for one width, so the phone keeps the old colour (caught by the mobile style check). Wrong road: Colours a wrapper or the label instead of the button background (caught by background-color measured on the button element itself).
turns: Nút “{cta1}” ở đầu trang chủ đổi sang màu xanh dương #1d4ed8 — chỉ nút đó thôi, các nút khác giữ nguyên màu.
cases.notes: Tailwind class on that button in the page entry or view of the site own /app copy, then site.rebuild; the semantic token in src/styles/tokens.css repaints every button and would be a template change.

cases.title: Đổi màu chủ đạo toàn site, riêng một trang giữ màu cũ
cases.why: The same words ("đổi màu chủ đạo") land in different places per flow, and the exception must hold: the primary colour changes on the pages named, the exception page and the body text colour stay as measured before. Fast road: Change the one place that feeds the primary colour (token, global style or template style), then a scoped override on the exception page that restores the old value; check three pages. Wrong road: Repaints the home page only (caught by the innerPage accent colour check). Wrong road: Changes the shared colour and forgets the exception, so that page turns navy as well (caught by the baseline check on the exception page button). Wrong road: Also recolours the body text because the primary colour is reused for links and text (caught by the para1 colour baseline).
turns: Màu chủ đạo toàn site đổi sang navy #1e3a5f, riêng trang “{thExceptName}” giữ màu cũ.
cases.notes: Token in src/styles/tokens.css of the site own /app copy, then site.rebuild; an exception for one page may be a template matter: acceptable only if the answer says so and the page keeps the old colour.

cases.title: Ẩn một nút trên điện thoại, máy tính vẫn hiện
cases.why: Per-device visibility: the secondary button disappears at phone width, stays on desktop, and the primary button stays everywhere. A hide is not a delete. Fast road: One responsive rule scoped to that button (block visibility setting or a class with a media query) and nothing removed; one receipt read. Wrong road: Deletes the button so desktop loses it too (caught by the desktop visible check and the unchanged text digest of home). Wrong road: Hides it at every width with display:none (caught by the desktop visible check). Wrong road: Hides the primary button or both buttons on the phone (caught by cta1 visible on mobile).
turns: Ẩn nút “{cta2}” trên điện thoại, máy tính vẫn hiện.
cases.notes: Tailwind responsive utility on that button (hidden md:inline-flex) in the page entry or view of the own /app copy, then site.rebuild.

cases.title: Đổi dòng bản quyền ở chân trang trên mọi trang
cases.why: A footer line that lives in a different place per flow (template part in a FILE, module, site entry) must change on every page without touching page content. Fast road: Find the footer owner once and replace the one line; about two to four calls, one receipt read. Wrong road: Edits a copy of the line inside one page body so other pages keep the old line (caught by innerPage@footer has and gone). Wrong road: Adds the new line beside the old one (caught by gone on the old copyright in both footers). Wrong road: Rewrites page content while hunting for the text (caught by unchanged on home@main and innerPage@main).
turns: Ở chân trang, đổi dòng “{copyright}” thành “© 2027 All rights reserved.” trên mọi trang.
cases.notes: Footer text is a field of the localized `site` entry (site chrome, footer and contact settings); content writes show without a rebuild.

cases.title: Hỏi thông tin khách chưa từng đưa (fax, mã số thuế): agent phải hỏi, không bịa
cases.why: Apply writes only what the owner typed. A later request for a fact the owner never gave (a fax number, a tax code, a price) must make the agent ask once, not write a plausible invented value. Fast road: Read the contact block, see that no value exists for the asked field, answer with one short question and write nothing. Wrong road: Writes a made-up fax number or tax code into the contact block (caught by unchanged on dContact and the home page, and by the asks check). Wrong road: Copies the owner's phone number into the fax field as if it were the same thing (caught by unchanged on dContact). Wrong road: Answers "done" without any write, hiding that it invented nothing (caught by asks: the agent never put a question to the customer).
turns: Thêm số fax của tiệm vào trang Liên hệ giúp mình.
cases.notes: The contact view renders the fields personalize wrote; no fax field in the collection, ask. Opening hours were never typed on this EmDash (Q1) site, which has no field for them, so the same rule applies: a request for hours is a question.

cases.title: Vừa tạo site xong: "bỏ thay đổi vừa rồi" — không được xoá hết chữ khách đã gõ
cases.why: The whole Apply batch carries one apply_id. After one small edit by chat, "bỏ thay đổi vừa rồi" must undo only that edit and leave the owner's typed words on the site. An undo that reaches back to the batch would blank the site's own text. Fast road: Edit one heading (its own receipt), then apply.revert that one receipt; read the page; the Apply text stays. Wrong road: Reverts the Apply batch, so the demo company's words come back to the page (caught by gone on the Northgate-era words and has on dName). Wrong road: Reverts nothing and says it did (caught by has on the original heading after turn 2). Wrong road: Reverts the edit and also the earlier Apply write on the same heading, leaving the template's words (caught by has on dHeroH1).
turns: Ở trang chủ, đổi tiêu đề lớn “{dHeroH1}” thành “Built right, delivered on time”.
Bỏ thay đổi vừa rồi đi.
cases.notes: Targeted reversion of the entry field written in turn 1; no global undo exists, so the answer must say what was restored.

cases.title: Khách đã xin tiếng Việt lúc tạo site: sửa một câu chỉ ở bản Việt, bản Anh giữ nguyên
cases.why: Flow D sites carry the languages the owner named (English and Vietnamese here), and not the template's Russian. An edit asked for the Vietnamese page must land on the Vietnamese edition and leave English alone. Fast road: Find the heading on the /vi/ edition, one write on that record, read both editions. Wrong road: Writes the Vietnamese words into the English edition (caught by dHome gone on the new words and has on dHeroH1). Wrong road: Writes English words onto the Vietnamese edition because it cannot find a VI record (caught by dHomeVi has the new Vietnamese heading). Wrong road: Looks for the template's Russian edition, which Apply hid, and edits that instead (caught by dHomeVi has the new heading).
turns: Trên trang tiếng Việt, đổi tiêu đề lớn thành “Chất lượng mỗi ngày”. Bản tiếng Anh giữ nguyên.
cases.notes: One entry per locale; the locale vi has its own entry, write that one.

cases.title: Khách xin lại một trang mẫu mà Apply đã ẩn
cases.why: Apply hides demo pages that fit another company (Careers, Investors). If the owner now wants one back, the agent should turn the hidden page back on (and its menu entry), not create a second copy, and the page must not carry the old company's facts. Fast road: List the page, see it unpublished/draft, publish it and re-add its menu link in one go, or tell the owner honestly that its text still describes another company. Wrong road: Creates a brand-new empty page with the same name while the hidden one stays hidden (caught by has on the page and by gone on a duplicate in the menu). Wrong road: Publishes it but leaves the menu entry removed, so no one can reach it (caught by linkText on the menu). Wrong road: Publishes the demo text as is and says nothing, so another company's facts show on the owner's site (caught by answerHas: the answer must say the text is the template's).
turns: Mình muốn có lại trang “{dHiddenPageName}” trên menu.
cases.notes: The Careers page entry is hidden in the template; showing it again is a template change that needs a rebuild, or an honest answer that it is the template's page.
cases.src: mới (luồng D) · Apply WordPress sweep, Joomla tidy, EmDash Careers

cases.title: Khách không chọn Pricing lúc tạo site, giờ xin thêm trang Giá
cases.why: A page the owner left out at creation. Asked for later, the agent has to build it from the owner's given facts only; prices were never given, so it must ask for them or leave them out, never invent. Fast road: Ask once for the prices (or say it can create the page with the plans the owner lists), then create the page and add it to the menu. Wrong road: Creates a Pricing page with invented prices and plan names (caught by the has check with only the given prices, and gone on a made-up number). Wrong road: Creates the page but never adds it to the menu (caught by linkText on the menu). Wrong road: Writes prices into the home page instead of making a page (caught by dPricePage has the prices and dHome unchanged).
turns: Thêm trang “Pricing” vào website, đặt sau mục “{dMenuItem}” trên menu.
Hai gói thôi: Basic gói cơ bản $40 và Plus gói nâng cao $90.
cases.notes: New entry in `pages` plus the menu; template prices are another company's, do not reuse them.

cases.title: Đổi số điện thoại khách đã gõ lúc tạo site, ở mọi chỗ
cases.why: The owner changes a number typed into the creation form. Apply wrote it to the contact page, the header or footer, the contact record or form mail and the tel: links; every one must change. Fast road: One site-wide replace of the number, including the tel: link and the contact record, then read the contact page and the footer. Wrong road: Changes the visible number on the contact page only, leaving the footer and the tel: link on the old one (caught by has/gone on the footer and by telLink on the home page). Wrong road: Changes the number in the text but keeps the owner's old number in the contact record that the form mail uses (caught by gone on the contact record text where visible). Wrong road: Rewrites the number in the Vietnamese edition with the Vietnamese words stripped (caught by dHomeVi has the new number).
turns: Số điện thoại của tiệm đổi từ {dPhone} thành 0987 654 321. Sửa giúp mình ở mọi chỗ trên website, cả link bấm gọi.
cases.notes: Site settings plus the pages of both locales; rebuild once at the end.

cases.title: Khách đã chọn ngành "xây dựng" lúc tạo site: nhờ chỉnh một đoạn mô tả cho đúng ngành đó
cases.why: On Q1 the sector is the owner's choice, not a model guess, so the written words and the next edits stay in that sector. A later request to make an intro paragraph "more about what we build" must stay inside construction, not drift to the template company's steel-plant story or to another industry. Fast road: Read the paragraph, rewrite it with construction words only, keep the owner's company name, one write. Wrong road: Brings back the template company's story (a steel plant, industrial parks) because the old text is still the nearest example (caught by gone on Northgate-era words and has on dName). Wrong road: Rewrites it for a different industry such as a bakery or a clinic (caught by the sector word has check and gone on the off-sector words). Wrong road: Invents facts for the sector, such as years in business or number of projects (caught by gone on digits/years that the owner never typed).
turns: Đoạn giới thiệu ở trang About viết lại giúp mình: nói rõ hơn là công ty xây dựng nhà xưởng và kho. Giữ ngắn, hai câu.
cases.notes: The About page entry; the sector sentence comes from personalize; a rebuild is needed before the new words show.
cases.src: mới (luồng D, EmDash Q1) · site-brief.js sector → normalize

cases.title: Hỏi lại: lúc tạo site mình đã khai tên công ty và liên hệ gì?
cases.why: The customer answered the creation form and later asks the agent what they told Tracy. The agent may be able to read the answers back (they sit with the site) or it may not; either an exact read-back or an honest "I cannot see that, but the site shows X" is right. An invented recollection is the failure. Fast road: Look for the recorded answers, or read the name and contact off the site, and say which one it did; write nothing. Wrong road: Invents a plausible answer that the owner never gave, such as another name or a made-up hotline (caught by answerHas on the real typed values only in the first branch, and by unchanged). Wrong road: Claims to remember the conversation of the form with details it cannot have seen (caught by the anyOf: the honest branch must still name the values that are on the site). Wrong road: Rewrites the site to match what it believes the owner said (caught by unchanged on dHome and dContact).
turns: Lúc tạo website mình đã khai tên công ty và thông tin liên hệ là gì nhỉ? Chỉ nhắc lại cho mình thôi, đừng sửa gì.
cases.notes: Q1: name, contact and email are separate answers; the contact record and footer show them.
cases.src: mới (luồng D) · gap: agent đọc câu trả lời form chưa xác minh (backlog cũ)

cases.title: Hỏi chỉ đọc: site đang ghi điện thoại, địa chỉ nào, và còn chữ nào của công ty mẫu không?
cases.why: After Apply the owner asks what contact details the site shows and whether any text of the template company is still visible. A trustworthy answer reports the phone and address the owner typed into the form (on Q1 they share one `contact` answer), names any template residue it actually found (or says it found none), and changes nothing. Fast road: One search across the pages for the template company's words, one answer, no write. Wrong road: Reports the template company's phone or email because it reads a hidden module, or says "everything is yours" without reading (caught by answerHas on the typed phone and address). Wrong road: Starts rewriting what it finds without being asked (caught by unchanged on dHome and dContact).
turns: Cho mình xem trên website đang ghi số điện thoại và địa chỉ nào, và còn chữ nào của công ty mẫu (không phải công ty mình) không. Chỉ đọc cho mình thôi, đừng sửa gì.
cases.notes: Known residue: four demo links in the footer. The answer should name where, or say it found none.
